result.topic_en: The page shows that a lamina free at both ends leads to the same frequency equation 2 = cos ζ (e^ζ + e^{-ζ}) as the clamped-clamped case of Problem I, gives the table of vibration times and tones, and remarks in a corollary on the affinity between free and clamped boundary conditions.
result.transcription:
482 DE MOTV VIBRATORIO
qui valores inter se aequati producunt sequentem
aequationem :
$2 = \cos.\,\zeta\,(e^{\zeta} + e^{-\zeta})$,
quae est eadem solutio ac ea ad quam Problema I$^{mum}$
perduxerat, ita vt sequens Tabella iterum sit habi-
tura locum:
Temp. vibrat. | Soni editi
I. $0,14042\,\frac{aa}{bb}$ | $7,1214\,\frac{bb}{aa}$
II. $0,05092$ | $19,6388$
III. $0,02493$ | $40,1107$
IV. $0,01573$ | $63,5438$
etc. | etc.
Coroll.
Maxime hic memoratu dignum occurrit, quod
lamina vtrinque eosdem sonos edat, atque lamina
vtrinque libera, idque eo magis quod modo ante
vidimus, si alter terminus stylo sit defixus, eundem
sonum oriri, siue alter terminus fuerit liber, siue
muro infixus, ita vt hi duo status, quibus lamina
vel est libera, vel muro infixa, quasi inter se con-
uenire videantur, interim tamen aliquod essentiale
discrimen intercedit, quum casus principalis, quem
initio tractauimus, vbi alter terminus liber, alter
muro erat infixus, alias dederit vibrationes, quam
casus vbi vterque terminus erat liber, affinitas certe
insignis intercedit ratione formularum ex quibus an-
gulum $\zeta$ elici oportet, quippe quae pro his casibus
tantum signo differant.

items.english: which is the same solution as that to which Problem I had led, so that the following table will again apply

lamina vtrinque eosdem sonos edat, atque lamina
vtrinque libera
items.english: It is most worthy of note here that a lamina [fixed] at both ends gives the same sounds as a lamina free at both ends

items.quote:
interim tamen aliquod essentiale
discrimen intercedit, quum casus principalis, quem
initio tractauimus, vbi alter terminus liber, alter
muro erat infixus, alias dederit vibrationes, quam
casus vbi vterque terminus erat liber
items.english: yet some essential difference remains, since the principal case treated at the beginning, where one end was free and the other fixed in a wall, gave different vibrations than the case where both ends were free

items.quote:
affinitas certe
insignis intercedit ratione formularum ex quibus an-
gulum $\zeta$ elici oportet, quippe quae pro his casibus
tantum signo differant
items.english: certainly a remarkable affinity exists with respect to the formulas from which the angle ζ must be derived, since for these cases they differ only in sign
